title: Return a small result
summary: Dart: Return a small result. Call twice with 7.
introduction: A function gives a calculation a name. The arrow form returns one expression.
learningObjectives: Return a small result with Dart

blocks.text: Install Dart 3 or later. Save one example as lesson.dart and run dart run lesson.dart. Flutter is not needed for these language lessons.

blocks.title: Return a small result
blocks.code:
int twice(int n) => n * 2;
void main() { print(twice(4)); }

blocks.text: The arrow expression returns twice the supplied input 4.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: The returned value must fit the declared type.
